action_items: (LOW/optional) Fix Directory.jsx line ~81 hydration warning by rendering plain text {t.common.currency} without a <span> wrapper inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at ~730 lines — close to 700 line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, destinations, reviews, storage, planner) for maintainability.

put_object / get_object use blocking requests calls inside async handlers (upload_file, serve_file). Under load these will block the FastAPI event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
/api/files/{path:path} returns bytes fully in-memory; large files will hit RAM. Consider streaming pass-through.
Trip planner endpoint has no auth or rate limit — could be abused to burn LLM credits. Consider requiring login + basic per-user throttling.
Review create allows unlimited reviews per user per destination — consider uniqueness constraint (user_id, destination_id) or update-existing behavior.
